run_dlrm_training: run the DLRM Caffe2 model training loop with configurable MLP layers, embedding tables, and optimizers via CLI
run_dlrm_inference: run the DLRM Caffe2 model in inference-only mode to predict click probabilities on test data
create_dlrm_net: create a DLRM_Net instance with configurable sparse feature size, embedding sizes, bottom and top MLP architectures
create_mlp_layers: create MLP layers with Xavier-initialized weights and configurable ReLU or Sigmoid activation functions
create_embedding_tables: create embedding lookup tables with optional weighted pooling and SparseLengthsSum or SparseLengthsWeightedSum operators
